thread:
elena (support): :rotating_light: ACME-PROD seeing sustained 504s for ~30m. Customers report API timeouts. Gateway logs say 'RequestQueueLimitExceeded' and dequeue latency trending >> p95. Request queue depth climbed from ~200 -> ~1200 in last 25m. sample trace: trace/8b2f3a. Repro curl attached below.

jamie (oncall): Jumping in. Do we have a tenant-level surge? Any recent deploys?

elena (support): No deploys reported this window. Customer admitted a sudden batch job that sends many long sequences (~8k tokens) to completions endpoint. They said they paused but the backlog persisted.

omar (eng-sre): Looking at infra metrics — continuous-batcher backlog metric (batcher.pending_requests) is spiking, kvcache.miss_rate also up. Many requests have large seq_len which prevents effective batching. Dequeue latency > 5s on several hosts.

taylor (eng-runtime): This matches an overload scenario we saw before: large sequences cause batchers to hold onto requests waiting for compatible batch. Batcher target size + prefix caching makes them wait. Immediate mitigations: 1) route this tenant to small-batch fallback model variant, 2) temporarily reduce batcher target_size to 4 for that pool, 3) restart the affected batcher pods to clear stuck groups.

maria (support-l2): Customer is very sensitive — they want a fix now. Can we do routing change without customer consent?

jamie (oncall): We can apply an emergency routing override for tenant acme-prod for 15m. That should cut queue pressure and stop 504s. Applying now.

elena (support): Thanks. Customer notified. Also adding their API key so we can correlate: key=ak_prod_acme_01 (scrubbed).

omar (eng-sre): Collected a sample error from gateway logs: 
```
ERROR 2026-06-12T14:12:09Z gateway host-12 request_id=8b2f3a status=504 error=RequestQueueLimitExceeded queue_depth=1187 dequeue_ms=6321
```
Suggest restarting batcher pods on hostpool acme-prod-batchers-1 to drain backlog. I'll coord with eng-runtime.

taylor (eng-runtime): Preparing restart. Command (run from ops jumpbox):
```
kubectl -n hosted rollout restart deployment/batcher-acme-prod
# then reduce target size
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/pools/acme-prod/config -d '{"batcher_target_size":4}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN"
```
Do note the rollout will briefly increase CPU as pods warm; schedule now if acceptable.

jamie (oncall): Go for restart. I'll also flip the routing override to fallback-variant.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Deploy request accepted. rollout of deployment/batcher-acme-prod started by taylor at 14:19:02Z.

elena (support): Customer seeing immediate improvement — error rate down from 18% -> 3% in last 4m. Still monitoring.

omar (eng-sre): After restart and routing override, pending_requests dropped to ~80 and dequeue latency back to p95 ~120ms. We'll keep the override for 30m and prepare a follow-up: suggest tenant throttling + request-size guidance to ACME.

taylor (eng-runtime): Logged a follow-up action: add an automatic small-batch fallback policy to routing for tenants that exceed queue_depth threshold. Filed RFC: INF-487.

maria (support-l2): Noted. I'll patch the support ticket with mitigation steps and recommend the customer shard long-sequence jobs or use streaming.

elena (support): Closing loop with customer in 10m unless we see regressions. Adding postmortem tag. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
